digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter — capability map, runtime guards, inbound probe port
propositions: Post-run Epic-field contract validation must refuse unvouchable reports, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json rather than using pre-run await gates.
Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary and hasattr-fallback logic to prevent silent failures when optional capabilities are absent.
Distinct reporting of capability-absent vs capability-raised conditions must be emitted on bridge_alerts channel rather than swallowed as silent skips.
The dormant inbound absence-probe port, its SupportsAbsenceProbe interface, classify_probe_response classifier, and related probe.py modules must be deleted from the codebase.
No live DC harness cells must be deleted, skipped, or xfail-ed by these changes; pre-existing failures on c87afedba8 are tracked separately and do not block this epic.
